subject: storytime
title: Henry and Mudge words
about: Henry has no brothers or sisters and no other kids on his street, until his parents let him pick a puppy named Mudge, who grows into a huge, drooling dog that follows him everywhere. This level teaches the words the child will meet in the book, so the library copy is easier to read on his own.
tip: After the level, borrow the book from the library and read the short chapters together, one each night.

book.author: Cynthia Rylant
book.source: a library favorite; this level teaches its words, the app does not contain the book
book.blurb: The first easy-reader book about a boy and his very big dog, and the day Mudge gets lost.

passage.text:
Henry Mudge dog puppy
big drool walk lost
found home bed woods
hug lick sad smell

cards.note: capital H, it is his name; y at the end says ee: Hen-ree
capital M, it is his name; dge says j, like in bridge
pp is one p; y at the end says ee: pup-ee
d-r blend; oo says long oo; drool is dog spit
a says aw and the l makes no sound, like in talk: wawk
all regular; s-t at the end
ou says ow, like in out
magic e makes o say its name
oo says oo as in book; the s says z
s-m blend; ll is one sound
the first a says u; magic e makes o say its name: uh-lone
